x1eqnsky.saveFailed.tip: Could not write the configuration file. Check latest.log and file permissions, then try again.
x1eqnsky.invalidColor: Enter valid hex colors (#RRGGBB), or theme / theme2 in the sky color fields.
x1eqnsky.themeHint: Prism follows this palette. Select Custom to use your accents.
x1eqnsky.enabled.tip: Replaces the sky using the original OpenGL engine. Requires the OpenGL graphics backend. Vulkan uses the vanilla sky.
x1eqnsky.preset.tip: Nine original GLSL effects. Shift-click cycles backwards.
x1eqnsky.naturalColors.tip: Use original preset colors. Prism uses the selected theme. Disable for theme or custom sky colors.
x1eqnsky.color.tip: Disable Natural colors and Follow theme colors to use this hex color. Also accepts theme or theme2.
x1eqnsky.secondColor.tip: Secondary hex color. Also accepts theme or theme2.
x1eqnsky.useThemeColors.tip: When Natural colors is off, use the selected theme accents instead of manual colors.
x1eqnsky.speed.tip: Animation speed. Zero freezes shader animation.
x1eqnsky.stars.tip: Star brightness and density where supported by the selected preset.
x1eqnsky.rotation.tip: Celestial rotation speed. Negative values rotate backwards.
x1eqnsky.horizonBlend.tip: Blend the shader into the horizon color.
x1eqnsky.matchFog.tip: Match atmospheric fog to the sky horizon. Underwater and other special fog are preserved.
x1eqnsky.sunMoon.tip: Keep the vanilla sun and moon over the shader sky.
x1eqnsky.hideClouds.tip: Hide vanilla clouds while Sky Shaders is enabled.
x1eqnsky.inTheEnd.tip: Apply the shader in the End as well as the Overworld.
x1eqnsky.resolution.tip: Full, 75% or 50% render resolution using the original upscale shader.
x1eqnsky.theme.tip: All 31 original x1eqn color themes plus a custom palette. Shift-click cycles backwards.
x1eqnsky.accent.tip: Primary theme color used when Color theme is Custom.
x1eqnsky.accent2.tip: Secondary theme color used when Color theme is Custom.
